title:
{@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Operation} represents the operation that is used to calculate the health of a model.
Since the operation is application-specific, this type is `abstract` and expected to be extended/implemented by
the application.
The minimum function to override is {@link #calculateHealth}, but {@link #calculateHealthBatch} can optionally be overridden
to improve performance.
This type is provided to {@link MlModel.HealthCalc.Job}, as specification of the health calculation operation to use.
name: MlModel.HealthCalc.Operation
